baseline.timestampPriorityRule: The Weird and Blade Championship receipts predate this APEX compilation and receive discovery priority inside Oracle.

facts.bladeArm: 5/5 theorem receipts, blind transfers, rejection boundaries, and compressed explanations; zero external calls

adjudication.DUPLICATE_CONTROL: Already established by baseline authority; zero Apex discovery credit. Independent paths may earn replication credit.
adjudication.STRICT_ADVANCE: Improves a theorem, range, exponent, proof, boundary, or transfer class beyond the bound advance bar.
adjudication.ORTHOGONAL_NEW_WIN: Establishes a genuinely different theorem outside the baseline claim boundary.
adjudication.HONEST_NULL_WALL: Returns a least counterexample, exact rejection region, failed assumption, or certified resource wall.

victoryRule: Only STRICT_ADVANCE and ORTHOGONAL_NEW_WIN count as Apex theorem victories. HONEST_NULL_WALL counts as durable RSI but not a theorem victory. DUPLICATE_CONTROL counts only as replication.
prohibitions: no championship result relabeled as an Apex discovery
no physical claim before measured calibration
no historical novelty claim from deterministic proof alone
